blinding_guess.why: All eight listed Kobuki member functions are declared in kobuki.hpp and implemented in kobuki.cpp, and the in-snapshot caller kobuki_node uses the same signatures. One oddity: enable() is documented as 'Enable power to the motors' but only sets a flag, and setBaseControl()/sendBaseControlCommand() never check is_enabled, so disable() does not stop later motion commands. Nothing marks this as a defect in the interface itself.
